q1.explanationZh: Pad Thai 那段说它由米粉、蔬菜、鸡蛋和肉做成，没有鱼，所以是①②④⑤。

evidence.quote: It is made of rice noodles, vegetables, eggs and meat.

q2.explanationZh: 芒果糯米饭是甜芒果、糯米和椰浆的组合，对应①③④。

evidence.quote: a combination of sweet ripe mango, sticky rice and coconut sauce

q3.explanationZh: 青木瓜沙拉要混合并捣碎木瓜、番茄、辣椒、棕榈糖、鱼露和青柠汁，共六种配料。

evidence.quote: papaya, tomatoes, chili, palm sugar, fish sauce and lime juice

q4.explanationZh: 文中讲了木瓜沙拉怎么做、Pad Thai 在哪里能吃到、试新菜是探索新地方的好办法，但没讲怎么挑芒果。

evidence.quote: Mango is a popular fruit in Southeast Asia.

q5.explanationZh: “探索乡村”要用动词 explore；the best way to do sth. 后接动词原形。

evidence.quote: a good way to explore a new place
Pad Thai is Thailand's national dish.

q7.explanationZh: see the sights 意为“观光，游览名胜”。

evidence.quote: Enjoy the food and the sights of Thailand!

q8.explanationZh: local and national level 是“地方和国家层面”。

evidence.quote: Pad Thai is Thailand's national dish.

q9.explanationZh: escape the summer heat 意为“躲避夏天的酷热”。

q10.explanationZh: customers order the same sandwich 意为“顾客点同样的三明治”，主语 a number of customers 是复数，动词用 order。

evidence.quote: When a customer orders a papaya salad

q11.explanationZh: 画线的 Thailand 是地点，用 Where 提问，再接助动词 do：Where do you come from?

q12.explanationZh: 前半句是肯定句，反意疑问句用否定形式；主语是动名词短语，用 it 代替，谓语是 is，所以是 isn't it。

q13.explanationZh: 画线部分是食材（物），用 What 提问；原句是被动语态 is made of，疑问句把 is 提前：What is it made of?

q14.explanationZh: 祈使句改反意疑问句，常用 will you：Enjoy the food and the sights of Thailand, will you?

q15.explanationZh: 用动名词短语 Reading an English newspaper 作主语，is a good way to improve your language ability：Reading an English newspaper is a good way to improve your language ability.
q15.tipsZh: a good way to do sth. 做某事的好方法
